title: Roadtripeado - Travel & Local Business Mapping System
subtitle: Interactive Location Directory, Award Milestones & Subscriptions
description: A robust Express TypeScript backend system designed for a road-trip directory and mapping service. It manages interactive map pins, user awards/achievements, real-time communications via Socket.io, and a subscription-based model allowing local businesses to show their locations and offer deals. Equipped with automated cron scheduling, Stripe payments, and structured Winston logging.
highlights: Built a secure, tiered business subscription engine using Stripe Payments for map visibility
Designed a real-time gamification and milestone system (Award System) for users to unlock achievements and free maps
Implemented live locations listing, category filtering, and favorites caching with MongoDB
Integrated real-time chat and support messaging using Socket.io and stored history in database
Configured robust file uploads to AWS S3 processed with Sharp, Zod schemas for request validation, and centralized API error handlers
Established cron-based automated scheduling for task processing and structured Winston logging
role: Backend development: subscriptions, mapping APIs, awards and real-time messaging.

title: Quran International - Comprehensive Islamic Ecosystem
subtitle: Quran, Hadith, Tafsir, Prayer Times, Real-time Chat & Subscriptions
description: A robust, scalable production-ready backend for a comprehensive Islamic mobile and web application. Architected with Express, TypeScript, and MongoDB. The system features a massive database for Quran, Hadith (multi-language), and Tafsir processing. It integrates real-time chat via Socket.io, robust subscription management with Stripe and In-App Purchases (IAP), automated notifications, and interactive features like bookmarks, highlights, and Hasanat (rewards) tracking.
highlights: Built massive data pipelines and storage systems for multi-language Quran, Hadith, Tafsir, and an Islamic Knowledge Library
Integrated real-time chat, support messaging, and community interactions for seamless user communication
Implemented a comprehensive dual-subscription system handling both web-based and in-app purchases
Designed interactive user features including bookmarks, text highlights, daily last-read syncing, and Hasanat (rewards) tracking
Configured automated push notifications to engage users with daily prayers, dua, and community alerts
Created an administrative dashboard system for content management, user support, and subscription analytics
role: Backend development: Islamic content APIs, subscriptions and real-time features.

title: ClipFrame — Content Scheduling & Meta Automation
subtitle: Social Media Scheduling, Content Workflows, Subscriptions & Analytics Hub
description: A robust, scalable backend engine built with Express.js and TypeScript for social media content scheduling, automated templates, and customized brand onboarding. Integrates AWS S3 and Cloudinary for file and media storage, Stripe for tier-based subscription limits and plan management, Socket.io for real-time alerts, and BullMQ/Redis for asynchronous background jobs. Designed with a clean modular architecture, comprehensive Swagger API documentation, and secure Passport OAuth and rate limiters.
highlights: Dynamic user onboarding flow with custom branding setup including brand color palettes and logos
Interactive weekly content planner providing clear checklists and structures for reels, posts, and stories
Multi-channel content scheduler supporting Instagram and Facebook publishing with custom reminder triggers
Customizable content templates with step-by-step shot guidelines, media durations, and pre-defined hashtags
Tiered subscription plans with weekly limits control for reels, posts, stories, and manageable businesses
Social media integration system for one-click connection to Facebook and Instagram business pages
Detailed workspace statistics and engagement analytics to track content performance and platform metrics
role: Backend development: content scheduling, social integrations and background jobs.

title: Ascela — Menstrual Cycle & Personalized Nutrition Tracker
subtitle: Menstrual Cycle Syncing, AI Recipe Recommendations & Wellness Dashboard
description: A production-grade health and wellness backend designed for menstrual cycle-syncing, personalized nutrition, and fitness tracking. Architected a scalable Express & TypeScript server that synchronizes workouts, meal logging, and AI-powered recipe recommendations with the user's current menstrual cycle phase. Features robust Stripe integrations for subscription management, real-time user features via Socket.io, AWS S3 image uploads, and Zod validation, all optimized for integration with a Flutter mobile app.
highlights: AI-powered personalized recipe recommendations with favorite, save, and swipe-based interaction system with daily usage limits
Menstrual cycle tracking with phase detection, calendar view, educational content, and cycle overview
Grocery list & pantry management — create lists, add recipe ingredients automatically, move items to pantry
Meal logging system to track daily food intake and nutrition
Workout logging to track exercise sessions and fitness history
Subscription & billing system with plan management, trial eligibility, pause/resume/cancel, billing portal, and Stripe Checkout
Admin analytics dashboard with platform stats, subscription analytics, and revenue overview
Flutter mobile app fully integrated with REST and WebSocket APIs for real-time features
role: Backend development and API integration with the Flutter mobile app.

title: Bean Fien - Specialty Coffee Hub & Analytics Dashboard
subtitle: E-Commerce Cafe, Loyalty Rewards & Real-Time Admin Console
description: A feature-rich specialty cafe application and administrative platform. It integrates a sleek consumer ordering web interface with a robust backend administrative dashboard. Built with Next.js, Redux Toolkit, and Recharts, the client interfaces with a comprehensive TypeScript Express server handling secure Stripe checkouts, Socket.io live updates, Redis queues, and loyalty rewards tracking.
highlights: Designed a sleek, dark-themed Next.js e-commerce storefront with responsive menu navigation, custom cart drawer, and interactive gift card tools
Built a live-monitoring Admin Dashboard featuring interactive area, bar, and pie charts with Recharts to visualize real-time revenues, order counts, and category breakdowns
Created a robust loyalty reward system with real-time star point progression bar and coupon claiming workflows
Configured a high-performance Express & TypeScript backend with MongoDB (Mongoose) for schema validation and indexing
Integrated secure authentication with role-based JWT access/refresh tokens and social logins (Google, Facebook via Passport)
Implemented asynchronous task processing using BullMQ and Redis, file uploads to AWS S3 with Sharp image processing, and Winston log rotation
role: Full-stack development: storefront, admin dashboard and backend services.

title: Photopia - On-Demand Booking Ecosystem
subtitle: Backend, Admin Portal & Mobile API Integration
description: A comprehensive media booking ecosystem. Designed and developed the high-performance backend architecture, secure Stripe Connect payouts, and built the Next.js admin dashboard. Also collaborated with the Flutter mobile team to design and integrate REST/WebSocket APIs, real-time messaging.
highlights: Built Next.js admin dashboard for managing service categories, themes, and platform metrics
Implemented Stripe Connect split-payment logic for automated professional earnings payouts
Designed and documented RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless frontend and mobile integrations
Built real-time notification scheduling and bidirectional Socket.io messaging engine
Collaborated with the Flutter mobile team to optimize mobile-to-backend data flows and push notifications
role: Backend development, Next.js admin dashboard and Flutter API integration.
